# The kernel is generated by overlap relations

**Hatcher, Theorem 1.20, kernel clause (page 43).** Under the full hypotheses,
including path-connected triple intersections, the kernel of the canonical
cover map `Φ` is exactly the normal subgroup generated by the pairwise-overlap
relations.

Intended artifact: `Hatcher.VanKampen.ker_coverMap`.

One inclusion is formal algebra: every overlap relation maps to the identity.
For the reverse inclusion, compare a factorization of a nullhomotopic loop with
the empty factorization using the homotopy-grid theorem.
